list.emptyBody: Clients are synced from the mobile app.

form.title: New client
form.intro: First name, last name and email are required. The other fields can be completed later.
form.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying: select the text by hand.
form.duplicate: A record with this email already exists: {name}.
form.openExisting: <link>Open the existing record</link> instead of creating a second one.
form.tempPasswordNotice: Temporary password: it will not be shown again

outcome.existingLinked: An account with this email already existed: it has been linked to this record without sending a new invitation. Its measurements are visible right away.
outcome.inviteSent: Invitation sent: the client will set their own password from the link in the email.
outcome.passwordSet: Account created with the temporary password. Share it with the client: at the first sign-in the app will ask them to change it.
outcome.recordOnly: Record created. App access can be created later from the client's record.
outcome.merged: A duplicate record with the same email has been merged into this one.

access.inviteTitle: Invite the client to sign in
access.inviteDesc: They will receive an invitation email and set their own password. Their measurements will be linked to this record.
access.passwordDesc: For when the client is in front of you or does not use email. At the first sign-in the app will ask them to change it.
access.noneDesc: No account: you can create it later from the client's record.

validation.passwordMin: The password must have at least {min} characters
